title: The Paying tile counts lifetime gyms, but tapping it lists only monthly and yearly payers
what: On All gyms, the Paying tile adds lifetime gyms to the gyms paying monthly or yearly. Tapping the tile shows the Paying list, which leaves lifetime gyms out. With 2 lifetime gyms, the tile says 5 and the list under it shows 3.
expected: The number on a tile matches the list it opens: either the list also shows lifetime gyms, or the tile counts only what the list shows.
how_often: every time a lifetime gym exists
fix_line: Make the Paying tile open a list of paying and lifetime gyms together

title: Needs you's 'new gyms to check' number does not match any count on the gym list it opens
what: Needs you counts gyms not checked yet that were made in the last 14 days, including gyms nobody signs in to. Its link opens All gyms with no filter. There, 'Need a look' counts unchecked gyms of any age but only those with staff, and 'New, not checked yet' shows every unchecked gym of any age. The same fact gives three different numbers, and Needs you asks you to check gyms the list marks as not ones to chase.
expected: One rule for 'a gym to check', and the Needs you link opens the gym list already filtered to exactly those gyms.
how_often: whenever an unchecked gym is older than 14 days or has nobody signing in
fix_line: Use one rule for gyms to check and open the list filtered to it

title: HQ says 'payment due' for a gym still inside its free trial, and never shows the stage the gym is really in
what: Once a gym has a monthly or yearly plan, HQ looks only at its paid-until date. A gym that paid one month early in its trial shows 'payment due' in red and is counted under 'Trial ended, not paid' a month later, though its free trial still runs and the gym server treats it as fully active. HQ also never shows the grace, basic or read-only stages the server moves a gym through, so you cannot see that a gym is already limited.
expected: HQ works out a gym's standing the same way the gym server does (the later of paid-until and trial end), and shows grace, basic and read-only by name.
who: MettleUp team, gym owners called by mistake
how_often: whenever a gym pays monthly before its trial ends, or passes its paid time
fix_line: Show the gym server's own stage on each gym row and page

title: The System page's devices and app members are counted differently from the gym list
what: 'Devices signed in' on the System page also counts phones of staff who were removed, while each gym's row leaves them out. 'Members in the app' there includes the test gyms without saying so, while the All gyms tile leaves test gyms out. The same two facts show different numbers on the two pages.
expected: Both pages count devices the same way, and every System total that includes test gyms says so.
how_often: whenever a removed staff member's phone is still signed in, or test gyms have app members
fix_line: Leave removed staff out of the System device count and label test gyms

title: 'New this week' on the Gyms tile counts gyms whose rows do not say new
what: The Gyms tile counts every gym made in the last 7 days. The rows mark 'New this week' only on gyms where someone signs in; demo and browser-only gyms made this week are counted in the tile but carry no such mark, so the count and the marks do not add up.
expected: The tile and the row marks use the same rule.
how_often: whenever a gym with nobody signing in is made
fix_line: Count new gyms in the tile with the same rule as the row mark

items.reason: Crispy Curves SQL: 1 app member, 3 register members, 2 devices, 2 staff; the members-in-app rule matches the admin app's list. The edge rows (removed staff still signed in, lifetime gyms, old unchecked gyms) are 0 in the test gym, so the differences are shown from code.
